[LADP.2.5.1] Rule authors don't write "this is a discovery-driven adapter" in
their code. The mode is a property of how the adapter was built.
What authors see:

| Adapter mode | What the author writes |
|---|---|
| Discovery-driven | `Sensor t where t.entity_id == "sensor.kitchen_temp"`, `Sensor m where m.entity_id ~ /_motion$/` |
| Author-declared | `SensorTemp t where t.topic == "sensors/kitchen/temp"`, `SensorTemp t where t.topic ~ /…/` |
| Fixed | `WeatherCurrent w where w.location == "home"` |
